bias.en: Range · rejected at $147, back under the 100-day
bias.zh: 区间震荡 · 在 $147 受阻，重回 100 日均线下方

read.en: SpaceX fell 3.5% on Nov 19 to $138.43, trading $135.50–147.29. It slipped below the 5-day ($140.0) and 10-day ($139.9), both rising, and the falling 100-day ($141.7) and 30-day ($144.4) (no 200-day yet, 112 sessions). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($125.82), and RSI is 46.1.
read.zh: SpaceX 11月19日下跌 3.5%，收于 $138.43，盘中区间 $135.50–147.29。股价跌破均在上行的 5 日（$140.0）和 10 日均线（$139.9），并低于下行的 100 日（$141.7）和 30 日均线（$144.4）（上市仅 112 个交易日，尚无 200 日均线）。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$125.82），RSI 为 46.1。

read.en: The $147.29 high stalled under the Nov 12 high ($147.60), and the close lost the $139.4–142.3 support (5-day, 10-day, 100-day, Nov 13 and 17 highs), now resistance. Resistance is $139.9–142.3, then $144.4–147.6 (30-day, recent highs) and $149.8. Support is $135–135.5 (Nov 16, 9 and 19 lows), then $128.6 (Nov 6 low) and $125.8 (SAR). A close above $142.3 would target $144.4–147.6; below $135, $128.6.
